actual: R12P durable run macb_453ca2d0c5b21b40_20240701_20260629_20260724T114255448623Z_9fcdb6d1 failed in planner phase before remote dispatch. MultiAlphaDurableRepository.create_attempt resolves run_id from the locked child row, but only inserts run_id when _attempt_uses_p0_2_columns(spec) is true. An initial remote_execution DurableAttemptSpec has spec.run_id=None and no recovery fields, so the INSERT omits run_id even though production P0-2 schema requires multi_alpha_combine_backtest_child_attempt.run_id NOT NULL. PostgreSQL raised NotNullViolation; no remote attempt was created. Expected: every attempt insert persists the authoritative child run_id; recovery-only columns remain conditional; identity/conflict/event semantics stay unchanged.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
